messages:
Diego (Acme): hey team — after our client deploy this morning, our /rerank call is either returning 422 or a valid 200 with all-zero scores. example payload we sent below. not sure if we hit a new validation rule or our client broke.

Diego (Acme): ```json
{
  "query_text": "how do i reset my password",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "Step 1: Click forgot password"},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "Reach out to support"}
  ]
}
```

Diego (Acme): curl returned 422 with body: `{"error":"missing required field: query"}` on some attempts, and on others 200 but scores: `[0,0]` with no explanation.

Priya (Support): thanks Diego — can you paste the full response for the 200 case? also which client / sdk version did you push? @Ava fyi in case it's a docs mismatch.

Diego (Acme): 200 case body: `{"results": [{"id":"c1","score":0},{"id":"c2","score":0}], "meta":{}}` client is our internal wrapper around node-sdk v2.0.0. We rolled that at 08:12.

Ava (CS): we saw a similar rollout a few weeks ago — some clients renamed `query` -> `query_text` to be explicit. Our API expects `query` (string) for rerank. additionally, the candidates shape should use `content` not `text`. seems like a double-mismatch: missing top-level `query` (422) or if the server accepts, it treats candidates as empty content -> zeros.

Luca (Eng): I can repro locally with their payload. server v1.14 currently validates `query` required. when `query_text` is present but `query` missing, we return 422. if client forwards `query` as empty string and includes candidates with `text` instead of `content`, the scoring pipeline runs but tokenizes empty query -> zero relevance. here's what I tried:

Luca (Eng): ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query_text":"how do i reset my password","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"foo"}]}' | jq .
```

Luca (Eng): server logged: `validation: missing field 'query'` for 422. For 200 case logged: `candidates content missing, treating as empty` which explains [0,0].

Priya (Support): OK action items: 1) short-term: advise customer to map `query_text` -> `query` and candidate `text` -> `content` in their client wrapper (example snippet below). 2) medium-term: eng to improve error message for 422 to mention which key is missing and add SDK breaking-change note. 3) docs: add explicit examples for both `candidates` and `documents`+`passages`.

Priya (Support): example patch for node wrapper: ```js
// before
const body = { query_text: q, candidates: items }
// after
const body = { query: q, candidates: items.map(i => ({ id: i.id, content: i.text || i.content })) }
```

Diego (Acme): applied that mapping in our wrapper and redeployed — rerank now returns non-zero scores and expected ordering. thanks! :rocket:

Luca (Eng): filing follow-up: #INF-482 to improve 422 diagnostics + add a note in breaking-changes for v2 sdk mapping. will also add an example showing `documents` with nested `passages` vs flat `candidates`.

Ava (CS): passing to docs owner to add an explicit table of accepted payload shapes. cc @repro-bot to log the repro steps.

repro-bot: recorded repro run 2024-04-05T08:35Z for thread 1723456789 (artifacts stored).

Priya (Support): marking resolved for Diego; reopen if anything else crops up.

Diego (Acme): closing from our side — appreciate the quick turnaround.
